tickets.ticket: How do I save a second delivery address for my parents' house in my account?
tickets.answer: Thank you for your message. A NovaShop agent will take over your request and reply shortly (Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm).
tickets.draft_answer:
To save a second delivery address for your parents' house in your account, follow these steps:

1. Log in to your account.
2. Navigate to the "Orders" section.
3. Click on the "Addresses" tab.
4. Select the "Add new address" option.
5. Choose the "Add a new address" option.
6. Enter the new address details, such as the address, city, state, zip code, and country.
7. Click "Save" to save the new address.

Note: If you want to change the address, you can do so in the "Orders" section, not in the "Addresses" section.

Shipping addresses are managed in Account > Addresses. Up to 5 addresses can be saved, and one can be set as default. Pickup points are selected at checkout.

The shipping address of an order can be changed in Account > Orders while the status is "Received". After the order is "Preparing" or "Shipped", the address cannot be changed by NovaShop; for a shipped parcel the customer can use the carrier's redirection link in the tracking email.

To switch between a personal and a business account, log out and log in with the other account. Orders cannot be moved from one account to another.
